prevention: Every static deployment must verify response-level headers, not only source files.
Never add unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval to enforced JS CSP as an easy bypass.
Do not break production public website scripts or OAuth with premature full strict CSP; use report-only discovery first.
RLS enabled without policies means deny-by-default; public broad SELECT/INSERT policies and SECURITY DEFINER EXECUTE grants require role-specific review.
Any public RPC granted elevated security must have independently tested authorization and a closed migration plan.
Never claim protected PR merged or browser restrictions enforced before exact provider readback.
